receipt.reason: Keep the three exact evidence-backed pre-finish criteria explicitly numbered for current acceptanceEvidence, while expressing candidate-tag, post-publication, local install, and cleanup steps as later-stage unnumbered Contract conditions. This follows the lifecycle boundary where these outputs cannot exist before the tag/Release and prevents any future-stage assertion from being treated as verified early.

oldValue: A1: The product/source diff changes only the 16 declared product paths; workspace/package identity is plain stable SemVer 1.0.1, localized version/distribution guidance is consistent, and historical v1.0.0 and v1.0.1-rc.2 identities remain separate. The exact six required Work Item/parity pages are governance projections, not additional product-source scope.

A2: The declared Rust workspace verification and every required repository gate pass for the exact PR #1022 head. Evidence records the exact head, workflow run/job conclusions, actual completion of all 13 package-coverage obligations, and the independent review conclusion without attributing agent review to a human.

A3: Before any tag is created, the Runtime-bound release plan consumes fresh evidence for this exact source/PR and confirms the real immutable v1.0.0 stable release is the N-1 source, v1.0.1 tag and Release names are unused, and the existing release workflow enforces candidate checks before public Release publication.

A4: Only after normal PR merge and fresh Runtime publication admission, create the new immutable v1.0.1 tag on the accepted merge commit. The existing workflow must build and pass candidate install/smoke for aarch64-apple-darwin (Homebrew), x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, and staged full N-1 upgrade from stable v1.0.0 must pass on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu before public Release publication. Do not substitute N/A or another predecessor.

A5: After public Release publication, download the official manifest, SHA256SUMS, and Linux x86_64 artifact; verify their identities and digests and pass public install plus N-1 upgrade from v1.0.0 with post-upgrade checks. Preserve any failure and never replace existing immutable assets.

A6: On the local Apple Silicon macOS host, install the published macOS binary at the declared absolute path and update the CLI/MCP executable binding. Verify that official archive/manifest/SHA256SUMS agree, record the actual installed binary SHA-256 and version 1.0.1, confirm CLI absolute path and MCP initialize plus read-only request. Check a local build only for source/provenance/version; do not require its binary hash to equal the official artifact or mutate provider-global identity configuration.

A7: After every release acceptance step succeeds, Runtime admits cleanup and close, and the exact merged PR branch/worktree cleanup plus final lifecycle receipts are recorded. No tag, release, or asset is overwritten or deleted.
